headlines.title: השר כ"ץ על התקיפות החריגות בעזה: "נעצר מחבל בכיר בחמאס"
headlines.snippet: Iran's President stated that Iran is working towards an agreement with the United States, and that war is not in their interest. However, the US President told Fox News that the US would respond forcefully. Following an attack in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran attacked US bases in Jordan and the United Arab Emirates. The Jordanian army reported intercepting eight missiles that entered their airspace.
headlines.title_he: השר כ"ץ על התקיפות החריגות בעזה: "נעצר מחבל בכיר בחמאס"

headlines.title: פרופ' עדה יונת הלכה לעולמה בגיל 87
headlines.snippet: Professor Ada Yonath, a Nobel laureate in Chemistry, has passed away at the age of 87. She received the Nobel Prize in 2009 for her work on ribosomes and was a long-time researcher at the Weizmann Institute of Science in Rehovot, also receiving the Israel Prize.
